name: Meowzy Pastel Mascot
description: Cartoony mascot look in the spirit of YAZIO for Meowzy (games for cats): light pastel background with a soft white glow behind the phone, chunky rounded dark-navy headline (Nunito 900), orange subline, Apple bezel (Deep Blue iPhone / Space Black iPad) hanging under the headline and clipped by the bottom edge; the orange-cat mascot is layered around the device per slot (decor).
recommendedFor: pets / kids / casual apps with a mascot
decorationsHint: light pastel canvas (lavender, mint, butter, peach, sky), one soft white glow behind the phone, a few yellow sparkles; the orange tabby mascot peeks over, pounces on or naps next to the phone.

samples.descriptor: Your cat hunts on the screen
